title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee
description: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee is an American animated television series, created by Judd Winick and produced by Cartoon Network Studios. It premiered on Cartoon Network on May 30, 2005, and ended its run on April 9, 2007.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x1
episodes_data.description: June has been doing her te Xuan Ze thing for just over a month and it's become a real hassle.  She's managed to flake out on her friends on a regular basis and has managed to acquire a reputation for being weird.  And now, one of her best friends, Jody, is having a birthday party.  June of course gets called away because the Leprechauns have let loose the Racatan.  Despite begging Ah mah to help out, June is forced to skip the party and save Orchid Bay City again.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x2
episodes_data.description: June has to stop a mummy who opened up his own restaurant.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x3
episodes_data.description: The spirits of Nordic Vikings take possession of June's friends and it's up to her, Monroe,and RayRay to get them back to normal.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x4
episodes_data.description: June battles Loki, the god of pranks and lies.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x5
episodes_data.description: June and Ray-Ray baby-sit a migrating Batoot.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x6
episodes_data.description: June tries out for the school talent show. But she must put her efforts on hold when everyone in the city falls asleep and they become victims of a plot by the Sandman, lord of the sleep realm.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x7
episodes_data.description: Many years ago, there once was an evil witch named Auntie Roon who battled the Te Xuan Ze of that time. She was defeated and also banished at the same time. Many years later, a 10th level Warlock has gotten together with a Pus Goblin and an Antelope Snake to release Auntie Roon where the sacred grounds are where the Orchid Bay Mall now stands. At the same time, June, Jody, Ophelia, and Roger try to get in line to get the latest album from the band called Ambiguous Angst. When Auntie Roon is released, she lifts the veil that was preventing the humans from seeing monsters and has her minions gather every teen and kid in one spot. How will June defeat Auntie Roon?

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x8
episodes_data.description: June becomes so busy with her duties as Te Xuan Ze that she asks for some assistance in clearing her schedule from a helper elf who is Local 492. But he ends up causing more trouble than he's worth. How can she get her job as the Te Xuan Ze done and finish her serious grounding matters at once?

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x9
episodes_data.description: Maret, Grand Arch-Demon of the 6th Astral Plane, accidentally kidnaps Dennis.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x10
episodes_data.description: June goes to performing arts camp on Edipan.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x11
episodes_data.description: The good 4th-degree sorceress named Ashley arrives in town while pursuing the Baguano. She volunteers to take over June's responsibilities as a bulwark against the forces of evil. June is tempted to let her. June tries to act normal and everything goes wrong. What will happen next after Ashley accidentally feeds a Fustertroll a cookie?

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x12
episodes_data.description: Monroe's father, William, comes to visit.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 1x13
episodes_data.description: The three-day magic convention called "The Convergence" has opened in town and June attends it. All monsters go there to hear her speak. But when an evil organization of bloodthirsty terrorists named H.A.M.(Humans from the Abolishment of Magic) breaks into the convention center and holds everybody there hostage for kidnapping, Ah-Mah is forced out of retirement to save the day.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x1
episodes_data.description: Every Halloween all monsters become humans for the night; but a monster called Mark has contracted an agent demon, Vikki Devyne, for make him human forever. Thanks to Vikki Devyne, all the now human monster children are unable to change back into monsters, and the parents turn to June to help. However, she has to make deals from getting a protein shake to wrestling a demon that goes by the name of "Jordan The Destroyer" managed by a Don King-hairdo styled wrestling promoter before midnight, or else they will not turn back into monsters and remain human permenantly. Will June do this in the nick of time?

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x2
episodes_data.description: Ray Ray drinks the growth potion and gradually starts to become a humongus dinosaur-like creature.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x3
episodes_data.description: June tries to help a group of magical demons trapped in the form of zoo animals from a wicked zookeeper who is really a demon named Gigi who drains magical energy from magical folk to stay young. When Gigi turns June into a ring-tailed lemur, how will she escape?

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x4
episodes_data.description: June and her friends are cloned by an evil demoness who plans to use June's powers to release her father Cordath the Conqueror from the magical banishment.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x5
episodes_data.description: June finds herself casted as the star of a reality TV show by the demon producer Jonathan and his assistant Michael.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x6
episodes_data.description: A demon named Jean-Claude traps June, her friends, and family within a snow globe during the "Bat Mitzvah" of Jody's sister Rachel.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x7
episodes_data.description: Magic brings Ray Ray's comic book hero, Boomfist, and his evil nemesis to life for an epic clash in Orchid Bay.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x8
episodes_data.description: After preventing a goblin from aquiring a magic stone, Ah-Mah narrates the story to June how Ray Ray earned the ability to see the magic before she retired. Also, in the flashback, three demons plot to use the Staff of Elusidation to find out which one of Ah-Mah's grandkids has the magic ability of the Te Xuan Ze and drain it from him. Monroe must watch over and protect the children while Ah-Mah fights some Fire Demons. What will happen then?

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x9
episodes_data.description: June, Ray Ray, and Monroe are sent by a pair of Easter Bunnies to Sweetland to intervine in an feud between the bunnies and the chickens, the latter of which are being led by Monroe's father, William who see this as a game.  Can monroe keep his cool and stop the war?

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x10
episodes_data.description: June needs to create a double to take Ah-Mah's place at a monster treaty negotiation and not skip school. But as RayRay gets involved in the magic the chaos begins.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x11
episodes_data.description: Monsters are scared for this menace and June can't to do something against it, now the only hope is the anti bat otter kit sold by Skeeter Khommen-Ghetit.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x12
episodes_data.description: June is ready to go to California, but when the elves free a Bombat, she must capture it in less of 6 hours or she'll lose her plane.

episodes_data.title: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee 2x13
episodes_data.description: The School Dance is the Friday Night, and June is waiting Marcus to invite her, but that's the day when Steven the Sandman is planning to return to Dream land during the dance.
